elo.note: Elo over Oracle's Elixir 2019-2026, league-aware start, 25% regression to the league mean each year

laneStats.source: Oracle's Elixir pro games 2022-2026 (gold / XP difference vs the lane opponent; LPL and some minor leagues don't record them)

emb.note: champion vectors z = F P + e (F: kit embedding + draft-profile attributes; P, e learned) from a factorisation model of lane matchups (z_a' S_r z_b) and synergy fitted on who won; cosine similarity = champions the draft outcomes treat alike, pulled toward similar kits. Not used in the win probability (held-out log loss got worse)
